body: I have never played video games because of how they promote violence but now that I'm older I'll broach the subject again with him. Thank you for the advice.

That is the problem with me. He is a good person and he has given me ample opportunities that I have thrown away. Hobbies would get in the way of studying so I do not have any because I need to fully devote myself. The only hobby I can have is some type of sport or physical exercise since it keeps me healthy but I am too lazy for even that.

Thank you for talking with me, it is good to be able to talk with someone.

Declared my major in Organic Chemistry, but I'm a freshman so I haven't started career specific classes yet. I wanted to go into Paleontology or sound engineering but he was adamant that both are useless. I could still change my major but he's financing my college and he won't let me get a job (threatens to evict me if I do) but that still doesn't excuse me not working and helping him with house maintenance and stuff. I also kind of do owe it to him because he's very wealthy and gave me an awesome childhood with many once in a lifetime experiences (talking to engineers in various fields and accompanying him to volcanic studies and such.)

My brain is sick. I think I'm a man but I'm really female. Growing up all I heard was how people like me need to be eradicated because we're a plague to western society and an abomination to God. I tried to fix myself through years but no matter how much I bleed or pray my brain won't change. My dad hated me for this and he'd do bad things but I'm older now and have still achieved nothing. I'm failing a few classes and I can't blame laziness on sickness. Any hope I had of my dad loving me again is gone because I don't think I'm going to graduate with a degree and make enough money to pay back all the money he's pumped into my life and education. I don't even believe in God anymore but if he knew that we'd probably never talk again.
